headline: Philadelphia Union extend winning run to six against Orlando City SC
dek: A 4-2 home victory completed a six-match MLS sequence in which Philadelphia scored 23 goals and conceded six, leaving the club 12th on 39 points.

sections.heading: A run built across home and away dates
paragraphs: Philadelphia Union’s winning sequence began with a 3-1 away result against Red Bull New York on August 29 and has continued through three home matches and three away matches.

CF Montréal were beaten 2-0 before Philadelphia scored five goals against both FC Cincinnati and San Diego FC, keeping clean sheets in all three games. Those results gave the run its central stretch: 12 goals scored without reply.

sections.heading: The goals keep coming as clean sheets give way
paragraphs: The last two victories have followed a different pattern. Philadelphia won 4-3 away to Sporting Kansas City and then scored four more at home against Orlando City SC, conceding five times across those games after the run of shutouts.

That leaves the Union with 23 goals across the six wins. They have scored at least two in every match of the sequence, with the five-goal performances against FC Cincinnati and San Diego FC representing their largest totals during the run.

sections.heading: Six wins reshape Philadelphia’s season line
paragraphs: Philadelphia now have 11 wins, six draws and 10 defeats from 27 MLS matches. Their 39 points place them 12th in the 30-team table.

The Union have scored 54 league goals overall and carry a goal difference of 10. The six consecutive victories account for 23 of those goals, turning the latest portion of their schedule into a sustained scoring run.
